items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Critical Magento account takeover via APSB26-92
items.summary: Adobe released APSB26-92, which includes a fix for an unauthenticated customer account takeover vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.1. Sansec Shield is already blocking exploitation attempts.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Amasty patches dozens of Magento extensions, 2 critical
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of extensions, with two critical vulnerabilities that can lead to remote code execution. Sansec Shield is actively blocking these critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in. This vulnerability opens the door to remote code execution.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered PolyShell, a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that enables unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files using polyglot techniques. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9, but older supported versions remain vulnerable, with attacks observed on 79.5% of stores.
